purpose: Define residual-gated escalation, benchmark, promotion, provenance, resource, and semantic-control requirements before selecting or enabling new OCR, multimodal VLM, or local semantic-agent runtimes.
authority_invariants: The original content-addressed PDF remains scientific authority at every tier.
Every local recovery result is derived evidence and must retain source PDF SHA-256 plus exact page and, when region-scoped, PDF bbox provenance.
A lower-cost tier may suppress a higher-cost tier only after the residual-specific promotion gate passes; otherwise execution falls through.
Failure, timeout, backpressure, missing provenance, low confidence, or disagreement never silently becomes scientific evidence.
EXTRACT and VERIFY remain STANDARD Codex jobs over authoritative-PDF context until a residual-specific semantic fallback is promoted by contemporaneous controls.
Existing validated specialized paths are preserved: CodeFormulaV2 for targeted formula pages and TableFormer FAST -> targeted ACCURATE -> PP-TableMagic for persistent empty-grid tables.
The broad parser bakeoff remains closed.
OCR, general document VLM, embeddings/reranking, and local semantic agents remain globally disabled until separately promoted.
Mathpix or human transcription may be benchmark references but never production authority.

escalation_ladder.role: Docling native lexical/order/provenance substrate plus standard_no_ocr structure overlay and deterministic quality signals.
Residual-specific already-promoted local components such as CodeFormulaV2 and the table FAST/ACCURATE/PP-TableMagic cascade.
Residual-scoped OCR, multimodal VLM, layout recovery, or local semantic candidate opened only by the taxonomy below.
Current Codex semantic baseline using the authoritative PDF/page/region context.
Final authority for unresolved evidence-critical ambiguity, benchmark annotation, or explicit human gates.

scheduling: A new heavy model must fit on one GPU with at least ~20% nominal VRAM headroom.
A new owner may not co-reside with another heavy owner on the same GPU if measured combined peaks exceed the per-GPU ceiling.
Queues are bounded; backpressure and timeout fall through rather than spawning duplicate owners.
All human-facing benchmark outputs are written under ~/adamArchives/Adam/workspace-control-tmp/.
research-engine-daemon.service remains inactive/dead unless a later bounded gate explicitly owns its lifecycle.

semantic_accounting_contract.allowance_observation: Record ChatGPT/Codex plan-allowance movement only as a separate censored empirical observation; never infer exact allowance savings from token counts.
semantic_accounting_contract.suppression_measure: For any candidate intended to suppress Codex, report eligible cases, candidate-pass cases, contemporaneous Codex-control calls, projected remote calls avoided, and exact token deltas.
semantic_accounting_contract.promotion_principle: Quality/provenance is a hard gate. Resource or token savings cannot compensate for lower scientific quality.

opener.production_signal: After model-free/native extraction, page has <32 non-whitespace characters and raster/image coverage is >=0.50 of page area, or the text layer is absent while visible page content exists.

quality_gate.requirement: Candidate must materialize page text with page/bbox provenance or abstain.

provenance: OCR token/line bboxes in PDF or deterministically reversible image coordinates
residual_families.fallthrough: OCR failure, timeout, missing bboxes, or quality below threshold -> authoritative PDF Codex control; unresolved evidence-critical content -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
residual_families.semantic_control: For promotion, run at least one downstream evidence task per benchmark scan case against candidate-recovered context and a contemporaneous STANDARD Codex authoritative-PDF control; candidate must not change grounded answer/evidence outcome.

opener.production_signal: Native text exists but deterministic lexical sanity fails: replacement/control-character ratio >0.01, alphabetic-token ratio <0.45 on a visibly textual page, or native-vs-standard same-page normalized token F1 <0.80 after excluding structure-only labels.

residual_families.fallthrough: No material improvement or provenance loss -> retain native/structure result and fall through to authoritative-PDF Codex when semantics are required.
residual_families.semantic_control: Contemporaneous authoritative-PDF Codex control must agree on downstream evidence/verification outcome on every promotion case used to justify semantic suppression.

opener.production_signal: A standard_no_ocr formula region opens CodeFormulaV2; escalation remains only when the CodeFormula request fails, returns empty output, fails deterministic LaTeX sanity/balance checks, or cannot preserve region provenance.

residual_families.fallthrough: Candidate abstention/failure/disagreement -> authoritative PDF/page-region Codex; unresolved formula used as evidence -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
residual_families.semantic_control: Promotion requires contemporaneous Codex interpretation of the same authoritative PDF formula regions on the residual set; scientific conclusions must agree even if LaTeX surface forms differ.

opener.production_signal: TableFormer FAST is unusable, targeted ACCURATE still has no non-empty grid, and PP-TableMagic either fails to materialize or yields an intrinsically unusable grid (<1 row, <1 column, or <0.35 nonempty-cell ratio).

residual_families.fallthrough: No usable grid or quality/provenance failure -> authoritative PDF region Codex; evidence-critical unresolved table -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
residual_families.semantic_control: Promotion requires contemporaneous STANDARD Codex answers over the same authoritative table regions for benchmark questions whose answers depend on cell relationships; local candidate must agree on grounded values/relationships.

opener.production_signal: A downstream evidence request requires information from a figure/chart/diagram whose extracted caption is absent or does not contain the needed quantitative/relational content; no visual-semantic pass is opened merely because a picture exists.

provenance: question/evidence need that opened visual semantics
residual_families.fallthrough: Low confidence, unsupported visual type, disagreement, or missing provenance -> authoritative PDF/figure Codex; unresolved evidence-critical visual -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
residual_families.semantic_control: Each promotion region requires contemporaneous Codex vision/authoritative-PDF control using the same evidence question and source region; local facts and final grounded answer must agree.

opener.production_signal: Lexical content is substantially present but deterministic layout diagnostics fail, including duplicate-block ratio >0.20, overlapping/interleaved column order, or native-vs-structure same-page lexical F1 >=0.85 with ordered-bigram F1 <0.70.

residual_families.fallthrough: If corrected order cannot be established without losing lexical content/provenance, retain authoritative page and use Codex for evidence-critical interpretation.
residual_families.semantic_control: For promotion, contemporaneous Codex controls on the authoritative PDF must agree with downstream EXTRACT questions whose answer changes if reading order is wrong.

opener.production_signal: Deterministic/specialized recovery has complete provenance but cannot uniquely select evidence, or a bounded EXTRACT case is known to be model-variant under current controls. Candidate scope must be bounded to <=4 authoritative pages and require no external-web freshness.

residual_families.fallthrough: Any failed quote/page/provenance gate, confidence failure, or candidate/control disagreement -> current STANDARD Codex authoritative-PDF EXTRACT; unresolved conflict -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
residual_families.semantic_control: Promotion is based on contemporaneous candidate-vs-STANDARD-Codex controls over the exact same authoritative PDF pages and request, not historical output alone.

opener.production_signal: VERIFY has a valid radius-0 cited authoritative page but deterministic checks cannot resolve support/contradiction, and all lower document-recovery tiers have either passed or explicitly abstained.

provenance: local verification rationale constrained to cited page
residual_families.fallthrough: Any decision/evidence-set mismatch, missing page, low confidence, or unsupported modality -> current STANDARD Codex radius-0 VERIFY; unresolved conflict -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
residual_families.semantic_control: Every promotion case requires contemporaneous STANDARD Codex radius-0 verification on the same evidence/page; the local candidate must match verified decision and accepted evidence-id set exactly.

sampling: Use residual-triggering cases only; do not re-run healthy born-digital pages merely to increase sample size.
Retain the seven-paper/73-page born-digital seed for non-regression checks of already-promoted structure/formula/table behavior.
Use preserved EXTRACT/VERIFY calibration events as selection evidence, but promotion quality is judged against contemporaneous controls.
contemporaneous_codex_control: Use the production semantic backend/model tier current at benchmark time.
Hydrate the original authoritative PDF/page/region, not candidate Markdown as the control context.
Use the same evidence question/request and compare structured result fields plus exact usage telemetry.
Do not materialize benchmark candidate/control results into scientific evidence state.
benchmark_control_policy.fail_closed: A candidate that cannot complete its benchmark without provenance loss, runtime instability, or an authoritative control is not promotable.

minimum_additional_benchmark_cases.minimum_content: One small scientific PDF containing at least one clean image-only/textless page and one degraded or low-confidence scanned textual page.
One scientific PDF with at least one quantitative chart whose answerable facts are not fully stated in the caption and at least one diagram/figure whose semantics require visual relationships.
required_annotations: question/answer facts with numeric tolerance where applicable

minimum_additional_benchmark_cases.minimum_content: One born-digital or hybrid PDF with a malformed/garbled text layer or demonstrable multi-column reading-order anomaly while the visible page remains legible.
Reuse the existing seven-paper corpus and only any formula/table targets that remain after the already-promoted specialized paths.

Select bounded EXTRACT/VERIFY jobs from preserved calibration evidence where current controls showed model variance or evidence ambiguity; no new PDF is required if authoritative source artifacts remain available.

families_to_consider_after_checkpoint: local OCR with layout/confidence and page/bbox output
local multimodal region model for charts/diagrams and only exhausted formula/table residuals
local text reasoning model with structured citation/quote output that fits one RTX A4500
exclusions: no embeddings/reranking work in this stage unless a separate measured residual opens it
no model/runtime installation before contract durability

promotion_sequence: Durably merge this contract and CI lock.
Acquire/materialize only the three missing source cases above and record their hashes/annotations; keep bulky PDFs outside Git.
Select concrete candidate models within the three allowed families and perform license/runtime review before downloads.
Run deterministic opener diagnostics first; invoke candidates only on opened pages/regions/jobs.
Record quality, provenance, resource, latency, exact semantic-token telemetry, and contemporaneous Codex controls.
Promote only residual families that pass every hard gate; otherwise retain fall-through to Codex/human.
Update localization-matrix.v2 or create the next measured version and CI-lock any production change.
Run a separate bounded Lambda integration gate before sustained research is reconsidered.
